gloss: difference in ability; gap in skill

definitions.gloss: difference in ability; gap in skill level
definitions.explanation: The gap or disparity between the actual abilities of two or more people or teams. Commonly used in sports, competition, and educational contexts.

examples.japanese: {実力差|じつりょくさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: There's a big difference in ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実力差|じつりょくさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歴然|れきぜん}だった。
examples.english: The gap in skill between the two teams was obvious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{実力差|じつりょくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}めて→縮める：04245_chijimeru⟧きた。
examples.english: Through repeated practice, I've gradually closed the gap in ability.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧ (real ability, actual skill) + ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference, gap). The ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ suffix is productive and can be attached to many nouns to express a gap or difference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実力差|じつりょくさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is a skill gap)
- {実力差|じつりょくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せつける→見せつける：14248_misetsukeru⟧ (to show the difference in ability)
- {実力差|じつりょくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧ (to close the skill gap)
- {実力差|じつりょくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}める→縮める：04245_chijimeru⟧ (to narrow the ability gap)
- ⟦{圧倒的|あっとうてき}→圧倒的：05853_attouteki⟧な{実力差|じつりょくさ} (an overwhelming difference in ability)
